exposure: women's life stages of reproduction (delayers of first birth, spacers of subsequent pregnancies, limiters of future birth)
cohort: The study analysed data from 2128 women aged 13-49 in two rural districts (Tandahimba and Newala) in southern Tanzania.
finding: Delayers of first birth and limiters of future births had significantly higher unmet needs for modern contraceptives (41% for both groups) compared to spacers (19%).
